Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the second essay! Mohammad Naim and Liton Das are the openers. Jacob Duffy to bowl the first over.
... THE CHASE ...

Right then! 162 needed for Bangladesh to win it. It is a batting-friendly wicket but someone has to stick around to chase this down. Will they chase it down? Stay tuned as the chase is coming up shortly.

A good batting display from New Zealand, they were off to a grand start, thanks to the power hitting from Finn Allen and Rachin Ravindra. Both though departed in quick succession. Colin de Grandhomme and Will Young also did not last for long and the Kiwis were in a spot of a bother but Latham and Nicholls then steadied the ship. Nicholls fell just as they looked to up the ante but Latham along with Cole McConchie ensured they finished strongly. Tom Latham was the star with the bat with a solid half ton.

Bangladesh did not have the best of starts as both the openers took the attack in the Powerplay. In the 6th over, Shoriful Islam pulled things back as he removed both the openers in quick succession. Bangladesh then managed to stem the runflow by taking wickets at regular intervals. They did manage to get back into the game and turn the momentum toward the end. However, the likes of Taskin and Shoriful Islam were poor at the death and let away all the good work done in the middle overs by their bowlers.
A lovely innings from the skipper, Tom Latham, has powered New Zealand to post a total of 161. 28 runs coming from the last two overs as well, so a good end to the innings from the visitors.
TWO TO END! On middle, this is hit down the ground for two. NEW ZEALAND END WITH 161!

Fifty for Latham! He has been the best batter for the Kiwis quite easily in this series. A good knock, they needed him to lead from the front as they were in a spot of bother after the start they got off to. He gets there by pushing this low full toss down to long on.

That is outstanding fielding! This is fuller and on middle, it is heaved towards mid-wicket. Longer part, it seems to be going all the way. Mohammad Naim there tracks back and takes it, he then realizes he is going to go over the ropes, throws it back in and saves 2 for his side.
Shorter and on middle, it is pulled through mid-wicket. One run.
FOUR! Nicely played! Finds the gap nicely! A full toss on middle, this is whipped through mid-wicket. This one races away to the fence.
Swing and a miss! Shorter and outside off, a slower one, stays a touch low! Cole swings but misses.
SIX! 18 runs coming of this over! A full ball, on middle. Tom Latham gets low and slog-sweeps it to square leg. The ball was in the air for a while but lands over the ropes for a maximum.
A mandatory concussion check going on as Tom Latham gets hit on the helmet.
A pacy short ball, on middle. Latham looks to pull but the ball shoots off the deck and hits him on the helmet. A mandatory concussion check for Latham.
SIX! HUGE! A full ball, on middle. Tom Latham gets on his knee and slogs it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! EDGY RUNS! A full ball, outside off. Tom Latham shuffles across and looks to flick but gets a top edge to third man for a boundary.
A length ball, around off. Latham shuffles across and looks to paddle scoop but fails to do so.
A full ball, outside off. Latham swings it down to long on and takes two.
Just the single to end! On middle, it is eased down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, Latham pulls it through mid-wicket for two.

NOT OUT! Cole McConchie is well in! On the pads, Cole is early in the flick, it goes towards mid-wicket. They go for one. The fielder htis the stumps at bowler's end. It is taken upstairs. Replays show that the batter is well in.
A run-out has been taken upstairs. Cole McConchie is well inside the crease.
Good comeback! Shorter and outside off, Cole looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Way too fine and it is another boundary! On the pads, Cole works it fine and this one races away to the fine leg fence.
A low full toss, it is hit straight to covers. A dot to begin the over.
Shoriful Islam is back into the attack.
EDGY RUNS! 9 from this over too! Fuller and on off, Latham looks to drive but it goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for two.
Back of a length and on off, Cole McConchie defends it towards point for one.
FOUR! That is nicely jammed out! A yorker on the pads, Cole McConchie works it through backward square leg. A boundary to get off the mark.
Cole McConchie is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Brilliantly taken! Superb from Nurul Hasan! This is full and outside off, Nicholls goes after it, it flies off the outside edge to the left of the keeper who dives and takes it brilliantly. Timely wicket as they now have a new batter at the crease.
Commentary.Howout: c Nurul Hasan b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Latham had given up there! The fielder had more time then he thought he had! A slower yorker outside off, it is guided to point. Latham wants one but Nicholls is not interested. The fielder picks the ball up and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. A single in the end.
Outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Taskin Ahmed is back on.
A single to end! So 9 from the over. On middle, this is eased down to long on.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Fires this down the leg side, Nicholls looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and goes behind towards fine leg for one.
On middle, this is swept through square leg for one more.
Fuller again, this is hit down to long off for one.

FOUR! Not the best of efforts in the field and a welcome boundary for New Zealand! Full and outside off, this is driven through point. The short third man fielder runs after it, he looks to push it back in but fails to do so.
In the air...But safe! A full ball, on middle. Latham sweeps it uppishly but in the vacant square leg region. Two taken.
A tossed ball, on off. Henry Nicholls leans inside the line of the ball and pushes it down to long on for a single.
Full on middle. Tom Latham sweep it to square leg for a single.
On middle. Henry Nicholls turns it to mid-wicket for a single.
A full ball, outside off. Henry Nicholls smashes it to covers who half-stops it and ricochets it to long off. Two taken.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! A shorter ball, on off. Henry Nicholls drives it through covers for a boundary.
A full ball, very full on middle, swept away to deep square leg. The fielder comes across and cuts it off. Two taken.
Full and on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Bowls this one quick and around off. Henry Nicholls chops it on the off side.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Slight short, on middle, it lands and spins away. Henry Nicholls cuts it but straight to point.
Loopy ball, on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter ball, outside off, cut away to point for a single. Just 3 runs coming from this over.
Touch fuller, on off. Henry Nicholls smashes it to covers who half-stops it and allows a single.
Angles a full ball, on off, driven to covers. Three dots on the trot.
A full ball, outside off. Henry Nicholls hits it again to covers and the fielder does well to stop it.
A tossed up ball, on off. Henry Nicholls pushes it to covers.
Very full and outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
A loopy ball, on off, Latham slaps it to deep point for a single.
Angles a full ball, on off. Latham defends it on the off side and looks for a quick single but settles against it in the end.
Flatter and wide outside off. Latham cuts it but finds point.
Around off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Slightly short, on off, cut away to point for one more.
Angles a full ball, on middle, this one stays low. Henry Nicholls pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Darted on the pads. Henry Nicholls flicks it to mid-wicket to get off the mark with a single.
A flatter ball, on off, punched on the off side for a single.
Henry Nicholls walks out to bat now!

OUT! TAKEN! The string of low scores continues for Colin de Grandhomme. Ahmed gives a bit of flight to this and serves it on middle. Colin de Grandhomme is tempted to loft this down the ground but gets more elevation than distance. Hits it over the bowler's head and Shamim Hossain takes a good catch charging ahead and to his right from long off. Bangladesh continue to take wickets at regular intervals.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamim Hossain b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Full on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
A flatter ball, on off. Latham dabs it to short third man for a single.
On middle. Colin de Grandhomme smashes it straight back to the bowler who half-stops it and deflects it to long off. A single taken.
Slips one down the leg side, Latham looks to flick but misses. Half an appeal probably to put the umpire off and it does as the wide is not signaled.
This one tails back in a little. Colin pushes it down to long on and gets to the other end. Good batting.

SIX! That is massive! This is trademark Colin de Grandhomme! Short and it sits up to be hit. Colin hangs back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. This should make him feel a lot better.
Another single! On off, Latham pushes it through covers for one.
Colin de Grandhomme is off the mark! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
BEATEN! Shorter and outside off, Colin looks to cut but is beaten as this one skids through.
Colin comes down the track and then pushes it back to the bowler.
Colin de Grandhomme walks out.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and Bangladesh are right back into the game. This is shorter and well wide outside off. Young looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge and the keeper takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Nurul Hasan b Afif Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: Slower and on middle, dips on the batter, it is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Timed brilliantly and a welcome boundary! On middle, this is swept nicely, through mid-wicket, in the gap and a boundary.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Afif Hossain is into the attack.
Another dot to end! Shorter and outside off, Latham guides it to short third man.
Got a hand to that one! Shorter and on middle, Young pulls, the man at mid-wicket dives to his right and gets a hand to it. A single only.
Drop and run! On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg and a run is taken. Good passage of play for Bangladesh.
Back of a length and on off, Latham pushes it to covers.
Soumya Sarkar is into the attack.
Yet another dot! A good first over by Mahmudullah despite going for a boundary on the first ball. On middle, it is played back to the bowler.
Quicker and on middle, blocked.
A single now! Angled into the pads, this is worked on the leg side for one.
Slightly shorter, some extra bounce. Latham looks to sweep but misses to get hit high on the pads.
On middle, Latham works it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! In the end, that is probably the right call! Lovely timing from Latham and that shot just shows it is a good wicket to bat on. On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket. Mid on hares after it, slides and pushes it back in. The ball though rolls back towards the ropes. He then does push it back in. They take it upstairs to check, it shows that his hand was on the line of the boundary while he tried to push it back, not on the cushion as that was pushed back by the previous dive but the line where the cushion needs to be.

OUT! BOWLED! Shoriful Islam gets his wicket! A full ball, on the leg stump. Allen shuffles across and looks to flick but the ball ricochets off his pad and rattles the stumps. On the last ball of the Powerplay, Bangladesh have removed both the openers.

NOT OUT! It was pitching outside leg. A full ball, on middle. Allen looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. They appeal and up goes the finger. Allen has a chat with his fellow partner and goes for the review. It shows the ball pitched outside leg and that is a good review from Allen.
Review time! A huge appeal for an LBW and the finger is raised. Allen reviews. Seems out.
Who walks out now? It is Tom Latham.

OUT! TAKEN! Shoriful Islam has the last laugh! Pitches this one on a hard length, on middle. Rachin Ravindra looks to pull but it gets bog on him. He mistimes his pull and hits it over the bowler's head. Mushfiqur Rahim from mid on, runs across and takes a forward diving catch. A much-needed breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Rachin Ravindra joins the party! A full ball, angling on the pads. Rachin Ravindra stands tall and lofts it over mid on and the ball races away to the boundary.
Very full, on off. Allen steps across and jams it out to mid on for a single. Smart Cricket.
SIX! WOW! What a shot! A full ball, slanting around off. Finn Allen shuffles across and whacks it all the way over backward square leg for a biggie. 50 up for New Zealand.
Tossed up, on middle. Blocked out.
A flatter ball, on middle. Rachin Ravindra flicks it in front of square leg and collects two.
A flatter ball, outside off. Allen cuts it to backward point who does well to stop it. A single taken.
A loopy ball, on off, tucked on the leg side for a single.
On middle. Allen looks to flick but gets a leading edge to mid off for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Serves a short ball, on middle. Allen clears his front leg and pulls it wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
Nasum Ahmed is back on.
FOUR! A big over for New Zealand as 19 runs come from it! A length ball, outside off. Rachin Ravindra looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge to the third man fence. Good start for the Black Caps.
On the pads, this is flicked to mid-wicket for a single. Sensible Cricket.
FOUR! A loose delivery from Islam and Allen makes full use of it. A length ball, down the leg side. Allen whacks it through square leg for a boundary.
SIX! BANG! A full ball, on middle, a slower delivery. Allen waits for the ball and heaves it all the way over mid-wicket for a maximum.
FOUR! Well played! Short in length, on middle. Allen shuffles across and pulls it fine to the fine leg fence.
A length ball, on middle. Allen looks to go over mid on but hits it off the toe end of his bat towards mid on.
Shoriful Islam is into the attack.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a length ball, outside off. Rachin Ravindra cuts it but finds point.
FOUR! This time he connects it well! A length ball, way outside off. Rachin Ravindra uses the width offered and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Another swing and a miss! A length ball, way outside off. Rachin Ravindra is way too early in his drive and fails to connect it.
A full ball, slanting across, outside off. Rachin looks to drive but misses it completely.
A length ball, outside off. Allen tries to push but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single.
A length ball, on off. Allen punches off the back foot to covers.
On middle, swept away to square leg for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Allen rocks back and looks to cut but misses.
Serves it full and angling down. Allen blocks it on the leg side.
SIX! HUGE! Again a short ball, on middle. Allen pulls it hard and all the way over mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! Slightly shorter, on middle. Allen pulls it to mid-wicket for a boundary.
DROPPED! Serves a short ball, on middle. Rachin Ravindra clears his front leg and pulls it flat and straight to deep mid-wicket where the fielder spills it out. It was hit very hard.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Nasum Ahmed.
Brilliant delivery to end the over! This one shapes away sharply. On a length and outside off. Allen swings and misses.
On a length, on off. Allen taps it to point.
A length ball, swinging away, outside off, it stays a bit low off the deck.. Allen looks to play across the line but fails to get any bat on it.
Very full and on middle, shaping in on the left-hander. Ravindra turns it to square leg to get off the mark with a single.
Finn Allen and New Zealand are off the mark! A length ball, on off. Allen pushes it to point for a single.
Starts with a length ball, outside off, shaping in. Allen mistimes his push on the off side.
We are all set! The players are out in the middle. Finn Allen and Rachin Ravindra are the openers of New Zealand. Taskin Ahmed to start with the ball.
The umpires and the players of both the teams line up and observe a minute's silence in memory of the umpire, Nadir Shah, who passed away on Friday.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo says that the pitch is not used in this series. There is a bit of grass and there is some dampness and it will be quite tacky. Adds that there will be pressure on the team batting second.

Mahmudullah, the captain of Bangladesh, says that they would have chased anyway. Says that the conditions are tougher for the batters but that shows how good they were. Adds that there was a hunger to win and he is happy with the attitude showed on the pitch. Informs the changes.

Tom Latham, the skipper of New Zealand, says that they will try and put a competitive total on the board. Adds that they were close in the last two games and the players are giving everything on the pitch. Adds that they need to stitch some partnerships and would look to do it today. Informs the changes.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Mohammad Naim, Liton Das, Soumya Sarkar (In for Shakib Al Hasan), Mushfiqur Rahim, Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Mahmudullah (C), Shamim Hossain (In for Mahedi Hasan), Nasum Ahmed, Taskin Ahmed (In for Mustafizur Rahman), Shoriful Islam (In for Mohammad Saifuddin).

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Finn Allen, Rachin Ravindra, Will Young, Colin de Grandhomme, Tom Latham (C) (WK), Henry Nicholls, Cole McConchie, Scott Kuggeleijn (In for Blair Tickner), Ajaz Patel, Jacob Duffy (In for Tom Blundell), Ben Sears (In for Hamish Bennett).
TOSS - New Zealand have won the toss and elected to bat first!

In other news, the 5th and the final Test match between England and India has been CALLED OFF due to COVID19 concerns. India's assistant coach tested positive and later, the Indian management felt it risky to continue playing. Safety of the players first. The series officially has not ended yet as India could come back again in 2022 to play the final Test. Awaiting for official confirmation.

First, it was the Aussies and now it is New Zealand. Bangladesh have certainly found their motivation before marching to the World Cup. There are still some worries regarding their batting but nonetheless, beating Australia and New Zealand in your own backyard is not everybody's cup of tea. Stay tuned for the toss in a bit.

New Zealand were questioned throughout the series, although they were without some of their international stars, they were beaten comprehensively by the hosts. With Shakib Al Hasan ruled out of the last match and Bangladesh shuffling the playing XI for the final match, the Black Caps would like to use this as an advantage and get a consolation win and end the series 3-2.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 5th and the final T20I game between Bangladesh and New Zealand. Bangladesh have taken an unassailable lead of 3-1 and have nothing to lose in this series. The track might favour the hosts but in the end, they were the better team whatever the conditions offered. Will the Tigers continue their domination or will New Zealand end the series with a win? We will find out soon.
... MATCH DAY ...
